people.name: Ahikam
people.line: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Appointed governor of Judah by Babylonians; assassinated by Ishmael.

people.name: Shaphan
people.line: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah

translations.web: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, “Don’t be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.
translations.bsb: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, swore an oath to them and their men, assuring them, “Do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.
translations.kjv: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well
translations.asv: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.
